It can be found on a desk inside the LexOs car dealership director's office, which is located in the closed section on the second floor. A [[Car dealership closed section key]] is required to access the office, and the [[Car dealership director's office room key]] provided by [[Peacekeeper]] via in-game mail is required to open it. Be aware that the premises of the LexOs car dealership are riddled with [[Claymores]].
